title: Formats
description: Every file extension a runtime knows about, and which of the two sources claimed it. Produced by usd_geospatial::formats_to_json. The composition declares capabilities and OpenUSD registers file formats; those answers differ exactly when a plugin fails to load, so each extension carries a state rather than the two lists being merged into one.

formats.description: Sorted by extension, so two reports of one runtime compare as text.

oneOf.description: A format the composition declares. The provider fields name the component a caller reports when the format is present but did not load.
A format OpenUSD registered that no capability declares, such as OpenUSD's own usda, usdc, and usdz. There is no provider to name: the composition never asked for it.
